title: If Omar Marmoush leaves Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Omar Marmoush is an Egypt international forward playing for Manchester City.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement from Manchester City or the acquiring club confirming Marmoush's completed transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window.
  • Qualifying Event: Either a loan or a permanent transfer qualifies. If multiple moves occur, use his first destination after leaving Manchester City during this window.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the acquiring club.

title: If Fabinho moves to a new club during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Brazilian midfielder Fabinho joined Al-Ittihad in 2023 after spending five years at Liverpool. This question is conditional on him making a permanent move to another club.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official club announcements or regulatory filings confirming Fabinho’s signing.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the first new club officially confirmed as signing Fabinho on a permanent contract between June 1 and September 30, 2026, regardless of his previous contractual status. Loans do not qualify. If no qualifying signing is announced during this period, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the destination club.

title: Which club will sign Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Ayyoub Bouaddi is a midfielder at Lille.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from the clubs involved or confirmed transfer reporting from a major sports news organization.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the club that completes Bouaddi's permanent transfer from Lille during the 2026 summer transfer window. Transfer negotiations and agreements that remain conditional do not count as completed signings.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the signing club.

title: Which club will sign Allan Elias from Palmeiras during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Allan Elias is a Brazilian winger at Palmeiras. This question concerns a permanent transfer rather than a loan.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official club announcements confirming a completed permanent transfer, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the destination club in the first officially confirmed permanent transfer of Allan Elias from Palmeiras during the 2026 summer transfer window.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the destination club.

title: Which club will sign Jaouen Hadjam from Young Boys during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Jaouen Hadjam is an Algerian international left-back who joined Young Boys in 2024.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement from Young Boys or the acquiring club confirming Hadjam's permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the destination club named in the first official announcement confirming the transfer. Resolution occurs on the announcement date, rather than the player's debut.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The destination club's name.

title: Which club will sign Nicolas Jackson on a permanent transfer from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window?
background: Nicolas Jackson is a Senegal international striker who joined Chelsea in 2023.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by the buying or selling club, or reliable news reporting confirming a completed permanent transfer.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the club that completes Jackson's permanent signing from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window. Loan arrangements, reported interest, negotiations, and agreements that remain uncompleted do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The club's commonly used name.

title: If Bradley Barcola leaves Paris Saint-Germain on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
background: Bradley Barcola is a French winger playing for Paris Saint-Germain.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement from Paris Saint-Germain or the receiving club confirming Bradley Barcola’s completed permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, corroborated by reliable contemporary news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the transfer is officially confirmed. If more than one permanent transfer occurs during the window, use his first destination after leaving Paris Saint-Germain.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the destination football club.

title: If Emiliano Martinez leaves Aston Villa on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Emiliano Martinez is an Argentina international goalkeeper who plays for Aston Villa.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the acquiring club in Martinez's first confirmed permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window. Loan moves and unconfirmed transfer reports do not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date the permanent transfer is first publicly confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the acquiring football club.

title: If Enzo Fernandez leaves Chelsea permanently during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
background: Fernandez is a Chelsea midfielder. This question concerns a permanent transfer rather than a loan.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official club announcements or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera Sport, confirming a completed transfer.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the club that completes Fernandez's permanent transfer from Chelsea during the 2026 summer transfer window. A reported bid, agreement in principle, or loan does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the acquiring club.

title: Which club will Gabriel Martinelli join on his next permanent transfer from Arsenal, if completed by September 30, 2026?
background: Gabriel Martinelli is an Arsenal forward and Brazil international. This question concerns his next permanent move away from Arsenal, excluding loan deals.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement by Arsenal or the destination club confirming Martinelli's permanent transfer.
  • Qualifying Event: Resolve to the destination club of his first permanent transfer away from Arsenal completed between July 1 and September 30, 2026, inclusive. If no qualifying transfer occurs, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The destination club's commonly used name.

title: Which club will sign Gabriel Jesus on a permanent transfer from Arsenal during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: Gabriel Jesus is a Brazilian forward playing for Arsenal.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official transfer announcement from either participating club, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the receiving club in Gabriel Jesus's first officially announced permanent transfer from Arsenal during the 2026 summer transfer window. Loan agreements do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the receiving football club.

title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
background: This question concerns completed transfers into Premier League clubs ahead of the 2026–27 season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve using Al Jazeera Sport's reporting of completed transfers after England's 2026 summer transfer window closes. The answer is the player whose transfer fee, expressed in pounds sterling, is the highest paid by a Premier League club during that window. Exclude proposed or failed transfers.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.
